name: QIXI airdrop transfers underflow the sender balance
summary: QIXI (Solidity 0.4.25) first sends value/100000 to each of ten pseudo-random addresses through _basicTransfer, which subtracts from the sender without a check, and only then debits value with SafeMath. The attacker's contract, holding no QIXI, flash-swapped all but 1e7 wei of the QIXI/WBNB pair's 6.894 WBNB and in pancakeCall transferred 999,999,999,999,999 QIXI to the pair: the ten 1e10-QIXI airdrops underflowed its zero balance to near 2^256, the SafeMath debit passed, and the pair was credited about 9.8e14 QIXI, which satisfied the K check.
notes: Reset: deployment; the exploit read no owner-set state beyond the default fee exemption flags, and resets.mjs shows only balance changes since. The token hides its owner (owner() returns zero) and has owner-only mint (mmm) and lock (BBB) functions, but the drain used neither; the attacker 0x2723e1f6, funded from 0x04545da5 eight days earlier, sent the deployer 0xe7ce2d40 a 'shabi' taunt (eip155:56:0xcdbe3a62249907d3fb8805132f5f5acccc1e38da5f4c921bbc3cfff581b306f6) after the drain.

Every earlier QIXI transfer since the pair's creation 40 minutes before (campaign.mjs) is a buy or sell through the pair or a bot whose sender held the amount, so no airdrop underflowed; the largest earlier WBNB outflow from the pair was a 0.27 WBNB sell. Loss is the pair's WBNB outflow in the anchor; the later QIXI outflows from the pair (0x37fea1bf, 0x978ffe43) took no WBNB, as the anchor left 1e7 wei.
